ayahs.1: By those angels who pull out souls with force,
ayahs.2: and those who draw out souls gently,
ayahs.3: and those gliding swiftly through the heavens,
ayahs.4: and those racing ahead with vigor,
ayahs.5: and those managing every affair by Allah's command—
ayahs.6: consider the Day the quaking Blast arrives,
ayahs.8: Hearts that Day will tremble in horror,
ayahs.10: They mock, 'Will we really be restored to our former state,
ayahs.11: after we have become decayed bones?'
ayahs.12: They say, 'Then such a return would be a total loss!'
ayahs.13: It will take only one mighty Blast,
ayahs.14: and at once they will be above ground.
ayahs.15: Has the story of Musa reached you?
ayahs.16: His Rabb called him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
ayahs.17: saying, 'Go to Pharaoh—he has truly transgressed all bounds.
ayahs.18: Say to him: Would you be willing to purify yourself,
ayahs.19: and let me guide you to your Rabb so you will stand in awe of Him?'
ayahs.20: Musa showed him the great sign,
ayahs.22: then turned his back, striving against the truth.
ayahs.23: He gathered his people and proclaimed,
ayahs.25: So Allah seized him as an example in this life and the next.
ayahs.26: In this is a lesson for whoever stands in awe of Allah.
ayahs.27: Are you harder to create, or the sky? He built it,
ayahs.28: raised it high and perfected it,
ayahs.29: dimmed its night and brought forth its daylight.
ayahs.30: As for the earth, He spread it out,
ayahs.31: brought forth its water and pasture,
ayahs.33: all as sustenance for you and your animals.
ayahs.34: But when the Supreme Disaster comes—
ayahs.35: the Day every person remembers all they strove for,
ayahs.36: and Hell is displayed for all to see—
ayahs.40: Whoever stood in awe of appearing before their Rabb and restrained their nafs from base desire
ayahs.42: They ask you about the Hour: 'When will it be?'
ayahs.43: You have no knowledge to give them of its time.
ayahs.44: That knowledge rests with your Rabb alone.
ayahs.45: Your duty is only to warn whoever stands in awe of it.
ayahs.46: When they see it, it will be as if they had lived in the world no more than one evening or its morning.
